name: Fairtravel Battle CCG
detailed_description:
Fairtravel Battle CCG is a fast paced collectible card game with a unique resource system and game modes for all preferences!

This game is a labor of love for the collectible card game genre, and it's a fun, fast paced game to play with friends or solo, without the need to empty your wallet buying card packs or keeping up with a meta.

Unique resource system!


In Fairtravel Battle, resources are everything! Collect essences and mana to play your cards, without restrictions on what kind of cards you can play!

Make your magic run wild with your own custom crafted decks and find cool new ways to make cards interact together!

Game Modes for everyone!


Duel

Bring your own decks to battle your friends or bots with up to 3 other players! Or team up together and face an even bigger challenge!

Explorer

Explore for new cards every turn to beat the competition! You never know what you'll get!

Chaos Raid

Team up with two other champions to defeat the Chaos Keeper! Or play as the Chaos Keeper and turn things around! Can you beat 3 other players?

Draft

Build a deck by picking cards among booster packs and win as many times as you can to earn fabulous prizes!

Sealed

Open booster packs and make the perfect deck to beat everyone else at their own strategy!

Online, Offline, LAN, it never stops!


Play each mode online, offline with CPU players, self-host, or use steam lobbies! Fairtravel Battle is built to last forever!

Make your own content!


Create your own custom game modes with your own rules right within the game!

Add your own new cards, cosmetics, and card sets through the mod system!

No Microtransactions for card packs!


Nobody likes paying a lot of money to enjoy collectible card games! Fairtravel Battle features no microtransactions for card packs!

Any future microtransactions will be exclusively new content such as new expansions or premium cosmetics as DLC!

short_description: Fairtravel Battle CCG is a fantasy collectible card game that lets your magic run wild with a unique resource system and multiple game modes, all playable online and offline with up to 4 players, all without a microtransaction in sight!
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, French, German
